biggest_catch: The amount depends on your National Grid rate class: regular residential (R-1) gets $50 at enrollment plus $20 each summer; income-eligible (R-2) gets $100 plus $20. You need a Wi-Fi smart thermostat wired to a central cooling system in Massachusetts — window units and non-central AC don't qualify.
catches: Must be a National Grid Massachusetts electric or dual-fuel customer; your account rate (R-1/R-2/G-1/G-2) determines the incentive.
Your smart thermostat must be connected to a central cooling system — no central AC, no enrollment.
Rewards arrive as a virtual prepaid Visa by email — activate it within two weeks or a physical card is mailed.
Enrollment reward sent within 4–6 weeks of enrollment.
You can opt out of individual peak events, but annual rewards assume continued participation.

steps: Confirm you're a National Grid Massachusetts electric or dual-fuel customer with a smart thermostat on a central cooling system.
Enroll your qualifying thermostat in ConnectedSolutions through the National Grid page.
Allow small automatic thermostat adjustments on hot summer peak days (typically 10–15 events, 3–4 hours each; you can opt out of any event).
Receive your enrollment reward ($50 R-1 / $100 R-2) as a virtual prepaid Visa by email within 4–6 weeks.
Stay enrolled to earn the $20 annual reward after each summer.
timing: Enrollment reward within 4–6 weeks; annual rewards after each summer season (June 1–September 30).
